nodes.text:
I) Health Concerns: The detection of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases in Bengaluru has raised public health fears, leading to cautious investor behavior.

II) Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) Outflows: There has been a substantial withdrawal of funds by foreign investors.

nodes.author: RajmalhotraDr
nodes.text:
III) Global Economic Indicators: Unfavorable global economic data and geopolitical tensions have further dampened investor sentiment.

IV) Sectoral Impact: Sectors such as metals, public sector banks, real estate, oil and gas, and financials have been notably affected.

nodes.author: RajmalhotraDr
nodes.text:
V) Market Volatility: The India VIX, a measure of market volatility, has surged by 17%, indicating increased investor anxiety.

Analysts advise investors to exercise caution during this period of heightened volatility and to monitor developments closely.
